chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 184 — The Village Fool & Corpses That Don't Decay
chapter_meta_description: Why did four nations suddenly stop fighting? Because corpses stopped rotting. Li Huowang takes an escort contract into Houshu and meets a village fool — triggering a buried memory in Gao Zhijian.
og_title: The Ceasefire Nobody Can Explain — Corpses That Won't Decay
og_description: The war ended because the dead wouldn't decompose. Li Huowang files it under "not my problem," takes seventy taels, and presses on toward a red-painted Gobi village where a village fool spooks his quietest companion.
twitter_title: A ceasefire built on corpses that won't rot
twitter_description: Li Huowang learns the war stopped because the dead stopped decomposing. Then a village fool makes Gao Zhijian panic.
